title: BrainRotViT: Transformer-ResNet Hybrid for Explainable Modeling of Brain Aging from 3D sMRI
abstract: arXiv:2511.15188v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate brain-age estimation from structural MRI provides a valuable biomarker for studying healthy aging and neurodegenerative disease. We propose BrainRotViT (Brain ResNet over trained Vision Transformer), a two-stage, slice-based (2.5D) framework that approximates volumetric context while combining the strengths of CNNs and transformers. A Vision Transformer is pretrained on an auxiliary age-sex composite classification task and subsequently frozen. Its per-slice embeddings are stacked into a 160 x 768 feature matrix and processed as a pseudo-image by a lightweight 2D residual CNN regressor, with subject sex incorporated at the final prediction layer. translated_title: BrainRotViT：用于3D结构磁共振成像脑衰老可解释建模的Transformer-ResNet混合模型
translated_abstract: 从结构磁共振成像（sMRI）准确估计脑年龄，为研究健康衰老和神经退行性疾病提供了有价值的生物标志物。我们提出了BrainRotViT（基于训练视觉Transformer的脑部ResNet），这是一个两阶段、基于切片的（2.5D）框架，在结合CNN与Transformer优势的同时近似体积上下文信息。一个视觉Transformer首先在一个辅助的年龄-性别复合分类任务上进行预训练，随后被冻结。其逐切片嵌入被堆叠为160×768的特征矩阵，并作为伪图像由一个轻量级2D残差CNN回归器进行处理，受试者性别在最终预测层被纳入。该模型在来自11个多站点数据集的5,108个样本上进行训练和验证，并在包含948个样本的四个独立留出队列上进行测试，BrainRotViT取得了验证集平均绝对误差（MAE）3.43年的结果（Pearson r = 0.98，R² = 0.96，Spearman ρ = 0.97）……
tldr: 提出了一种两阶段2.5D混合框架BrainRotViT，将预训练视觉Transformer与轻量级残差CNN相结合，从结构MRI中实现准确且可解释的脑年龄估计，验证集平均绝对误差仅3.43年。
en_tdlr: BrainRotViT, a two-stage 2.5D hybrid framework combining a pretrained Vision Transformer with a lightweight residual CNN, achieves accurate and explainable brain-age estimation from structural MRI with a validation MAE of 3.43 years.
